answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing each newcomer to lease a scarce settlement pipe. The applicant deposits a copper reserve into a delayed-release haven vault and publishes a one-time basalt commitment derived from its first signed heartbeat. Established peers will only countersign after they recompute that commitment and confirm the reserve is not reused. If two identities share a commitment or recycle collateral, the vault slashes every linked deposit and docks the sponsors, making mass clone farms more expensive than honest single-identity work.
